title: mRNA sequence data of individual Drosophila melanogaster male and female flies from 16 Drosophila Genetic Reference Panel lines reared in replicated environments
assay_types: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
decision: An explicit blocking and replication policy is required. Distinguish individual flies from repeated libraries. The record describes more than one FlyBase reference release; keep them separate.

rights.reason: GEO public access does not establish unrestricted redistribution permission. Source-specific review remains open.

scorecard_note: Unreviewed fields remain null. A number would imply sample-level review that has not occurred.
